events.evidence: The United States and United Kingdom launch airstrikes against Houthi-controlled areas in Yemen in response to attacks on international trade in the Red Sea
The death toll from the magnitude 7.6 earthquake in the Noto Peninsula in Ishikawa Prefecture, Japan, on January 1, increases to 215 people
British prime minister Rishi Sunak visits Kyiv to reiterate his support for Ukraine

label.note: Red Sea strikes threaten trade; Japan earthquake and Ukraine support add geopolitical uncertainty.
